name: road_build
doc: Builds one road cell from its kind (a config entry: surface, verge, ruts, a quay, a half's edge piece, lamps, sign posts, planters, clutter), what each neighbour is (a 6-edge mask: road, a building's front or side, open land, water, wall, gate, a waterfront), which half of the hex an edge piece takes (a market stall, a bench, crates, a planter, a cart, facing the free half so every way through stays open), which edges carry a fence (left clear for fence_v1), and its role (a path, a bridge): paving broken into stones, ruts along the flow, verges, kerbs, planters and crates in the strips along buildings, lamp posts with flickering lanterns, sign posts at junctions, quays and bollards, a bridge deck with rails; its flow, collision, and viewer guides (neighbours, flow, half, fences).
